text:
Evan Brooks: Heads-up 11 Finance + Product need standardized inputs from hardware partners for our cost model refresh. Key things: reserved tenor discounts, spot preempt cadence by hour/daypart, minimum committed hours, crediting method (invoice offset / future credit), and any marketplace listing fees. Can partners drop a one-line CSV sample and quick notes?

Sofia Mendes: Pls include timezone for blackout windows and whether credits are prorated by unused hours or flat per-eviction. tiny header suggestion: sku,region,tenor_months,min_hours,evict_per_1000h,credit_pct,credit_style,tenor_discount_pct,listing_fee_usd,blackout_start,blackout_end,notes

Kai Nakamura: Also tag if you support cross-zone warm migration (we model ramp hours differently). For spot, a 7x24 hourly probability vector is ideal but a short weekday/weekend split is ok.

Noah Reed (NovaCompute): Hi all 1 attaching our A40-like SKU sample inline. Tenor discounts are graduated (3/6/12 months). Credits are prorated to usage and issued as invoice-offset within 5 business days. Listing fee applies for marketplace bundles. Blackout windows are local tz.

Noah Reed (NovaCompute):
```
sku,region,tenor_months,min_hours,evict_per_1000h,credit_pct,credit_style,tenor_discount_pct,listing_fee_usd,blackout_start,blackout_end,notes
nova-a40,us-west,3;6;12,300,4.2,30,prorated_invoice_offset,2;4;8,150,3rd_sun_02:00,3rd_sun_05:00,"cross-zone-warm-migration:yes;ramp_hours:6;daypart_eviction_pattern:weekday_high_night_low"
```

Iris Chen: Nice. quick clarifying q: tenor_discount_pct field uses semicolon-delimited list matching tenor_months -- confirm?

Noah Reed (NovaCompute): yes semicolons map to the tenor list. we can also provide a normalized per-hour effective price table if you prefer.

Evan Brooks: That mapping works. Finance prefers both (1) tenor multipliers and (2) a precomputed effective_hourly_usd for 40/70/100% utilization points if available.

accounting-bot: Reminder to upload any actual CSVs to /partners/cost-inputs/ and include partner name + date in filename.

Sofia Mendes: If partners offer invoice-offset vs future-credit options by customer tier, include credit_style_column values like "invoice-offset:72h" or "future-credit:net30" so accounting can pick treatment.

Noah Reed (NovaCompute): will upload full CSV + small daypart availability matrix by EOD tomorrow.

Evan Brooks: Great. we'll validate schema and run a quick sensitivity sweep. If any partners have special SLA rebates for availability >99.9% include that as sla_rebate_pct.

Iris Chen: Also, flag any SKUs that cannot be shiftable across regions (we treat as hard binds). add column shiftable:true/false.

Noah Reed (NovaCompute): noted. adding shiftable:true for nova-a40.

Evan Brooks: Thanks everyone 1 I'll post the ingestion spec after schema tweaks.
